title: Didn't work for me
text: Didn't work for me. Charged it overnight. Added Dial liquid soap. Pushed the power button and it flashed once to turn on. Put my hand out. It made a sound but nothing came out. Pushed the power button and it flashed twice to turn off. Turned it off and on a bunch of times. It would only make a dispensing sound after I turned it on. The other times it would sense my hand and didn't do anything. I thought maybe my soap was too thick so I tried using just water. Still nothing. Does not work.
